sections.heading: C2 — Traffic signals and pavement markings
sections.markdown:
## C2 — Traffic signals and pavement markings

FACT_ID: sec06-R01 | anchor: A58
Pavement markings separate lanes and identify passing restrictions, lane-change restrictions, turn lanes, pedestrian areas and stopping places. [A58]
Source: [A58 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0058]

FACT_ID: sec06-R02 | anchor: A58
A dashed yellow center line may be crossed from either lane when doing so is safe. [A58]
Source: [A58 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0058]

FACT_ID: sec06-R03 | anchor: A58
With one solid yellow line beside one dashed yellow line, only traffic on the dashed-line side may cross the lines to pass. [A58]
Source: [A58 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0058]

FACT_ID: sec06-R04 | anchor: A58
Double solid yellow center lines prohibit passing from either traffic lane. [A58]
Source: [A58 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0058]

FACT_ID: sec06-R05 | anchor: A58
Double solid yellow lines may be crossed for a turn only when it is safe. [A58]
Source: [A58 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0058]

FACT_ID: sec06-R06 | anchor: A58
When it is safe, a driver may cross double yellow lines to turn left into or out of a driveway or business entrance. [A58]
Source: [A58 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0058]

FACT_ID: sec06-R07 | anchor: A58
A shared center lane is reserved for left turns, or U-turns where permitted, from either direction of travel. [A58]
Source: [A58 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0058]

FACT_ID: sec06-R08 | anchor: A58
A shared center turn lane has a solid yellow line and a dashed yellow line along each side. [A58]
Source: [A58 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0058]

FACT_ID: sec06-R09 | anchor: A58
Do not use a shared center turn lane for through travel. [A58]
Source: [A58 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0058]

FACT_ID: sec06-R10 | anchor: A58
Do not interfere with a vehicle preparing to turn from a shared center turn lane. [A58]
Source: [A58 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0058]

FACT_ID: sec06-R11 | anchor: A59
Broken white lines separate lanes moving in the same direction on a multilane road. [A59]
Source: [A59 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0059]

FACT_ID: sec06-R12 | anchor: A59
Drive inside the broken white lane boundaries rather than straddling them. [A59]
Source: [A59 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0059]

FACT_ID: sec06-R13 | anchor: A59
Cross a broken white lane line only for a lane change that can be made safely. [A59]
Source: [A59 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0059]

FACT_ID: sec06-R14 | anchor: A59
Solid white edge lines mark the side boundary of the road. [A59]
Source: [A59 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0059]

FACT_ID: sec06-R15 | anchor: A59
White edge lines help drivers stay on the road at night or in poor weather. [A59]
Source: [A59 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0059]

FACT_ID: sec06-R16 | anchor: A59
Avoid changing between same-direction traffic lanes where a solid white line separates them. [A59]
Source: [A59 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0059]

FACT_ID: sec06-R17 | anchor: A59
A solid white boundary with a bicycle symbol designates an area for bicycle traffic only. [A59]
Source: [A59 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0059]

FACT_ID: sec06-R18 | anchor: A59
Bicycles in the designated bicycle area must travel in the same direction as adjacent traffic. [A59]
Source: [A59 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0059]

FACT_ID: sec06-R19 | anchor: A59
Double solid white lane markings prohibit lane changes where they are present. [A59]
Source: [A59 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0059]

FACT_ID: sec06-R20 | anchor: A59
A dashed bicycle-lane boundary allows a right-turning driver to merge right and a left-turning bicyclist to merge left. [A59]
Source: [A59 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0059]

FACT_ID: sec06-R21 | anchor: A59
The handbook places dashed bicycle-lane lines at intersections or some driveway areas. [A59]
Source: [A59 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0059]
